experience.headline: Data analysis backed by software and QA experience.

items.text: Investigates data and operational anomalies across Salesforce and connected systems using SQL and record-level analysis to identify root causes and support corrective action. Builds and maintains recurring reporting, automation, audience, and data-quality processes while supporting cross-system migration and reconciliation work. Developed proactive SQL-based audit and monitoring processes to surface operational risks, improve data reliability, and reduce manual review.

Developed SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications supporting internal operational workflows. Built repeatable data processes that reduced manual work and improved maintainability.

roles.text: Advanced from volunteer contributor to paid QA and live-operations support. Performed regression and pre-release testing, reproduced defects, investigated unexpected system behavior, validated fixes, and documented actionable findings for developers. This work established the troubleshooting mindset I now apply to data and operational analysis.

Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, validated data consistency, and documented defects with clear reproduction steps. Earned additional responsibility through dependable testing, communication, and follow-through.

selectedWork.headline: Operational problems solved with data.
selectedWork.intro: A few examples of how I use data, investigation, and automation to solve operational problems.

items.title: Operational Audit & Monitoring Framework
items.text: Designed reusable SQL-based monitoring for automated data workflows with historical logging and severity thresholds. The framework was built to surface data-quality issues, automation failures, contactability risks, and other operational problems in a consistent and reviewable way.
evidence: Historical audit logging and severity-based issue classification
Reusable SQL for data quality and process-health monitoring
Reduced manual review; foundation for proactive alerting and dashboarding
items.outcome: One company-level reachability analysis identified 473 organizations without an assigned primary contact.

items.title: Payment Reminder Data Quality Investigation
items.text: Proactively identified data-quality problems in a customer payment-reminder audience before deployment. Investigated the reporting logic and manual workarounds used to build the audience, partnered with stakeholders to clarify business rules, and helped validate the corrected dataset.
items.outcome: The campaign was paused and the audience rebuilt before inaccurate communications were sent.

items.title: Cross-System Migration & Data Validation
items.text: Investigated discrepancies during migration from legacy systems to Salesforce/Nimble by analyzing conversion failures, comparing record counts and business logic across systems, reconciling identifiers, and documenting verified issues for corrective action.
evidence: Error-log analysis and cross-system record comparison
Vendor follow-up with verified examples to prevent downstream reporting and operational discrepancies
